description: Water Supply - Daily Volume observed for storage dams operated by Melbourne Water is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Melbourne Water Corporation. Daily observed Storage Dam Volumes at 10 Water Storage Dams operated by Melbourne Water. This data is collected with telemetry devices installed at the storage dams, and verified with field observations. The storage volume is recorded at 8:00 am daily. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Melbourne Water Corporation. Its tags are Open Data, dam levels, storage dams, volumes, water. It offers 11 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
